text:
maya: Quick heads up — seeing duplicate onboarding survey rows in CRM for same user after yesterday's webhook tweak. Playbook seems to fire twice for the same submission. Anyone else?
zara: Ugh — do we have an example user id or message id?
maya: user_id 100983, survey_id surv_2026_03. CRM shows two contacts, same email. Logs from webhook gateway show two POSTs within 200ms:
```
POST /webhook/survey 200 0.21ms payload_id=abc123
POST /webhook/survey 200 0.22ms payload_id=abc123
```
maya: payload_id is the same — the producer retried but we didn't check idempotency before playbook trigger.
liam: @maya I rolled out the 'retries->backoff' patch but forgot to add idempotency header to the payload. Fix incoming.
patrick: Is there a quick mitigation? Can we pause the playbook step?
maya: Yes, you can disable the 'survey->create-touchpoint' rule from Console > Playbooks > Onboarding > steps. Doing that now :gear:.
ops-bot: Deploy started by liam — build #5241 — ETA ~2m
liam: Patch pushed: added `idempotency_key` = `payload_id` in webhook. Also added check in playbook runner: if seen_keys contains key skip. PR: https://git/redwood/pull/3491
zara: Nice. After deploy, we should dedupe the CRM rows and backfill correct touchpoint timestamps.
cs-eng: Running backfill SQL now:
```
WITH dupes AS (
  SELECT email, min(id) AS keep_id, array_agg(id) AS all_ids
  FROM contacts
  WHERE source='onboarding-survey'
  GROUP BY email
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)
UPDATE contacts SET canonical_id = d.keep_id
FROM dupes d
WHERE contacts.email = d.email AND contacts.id != d.keep_id;
```
cs-eng: I'll also run a script to merge notes and touchpoints. ETA 30m.
maya: Assigning follow-ups: liam -> confirm deploy and monitor; cs-eng -> dedupe & merge; zara -> verify playbook rules and add test case. Reopen if anything else.
patrick: :thumbsup: marking as incident for tracking. Incident ID: CS-2026-031. last checked 1799994345
